ui_bugs.issue: After a round that produces a Level Up, a mid-screen 'LEVEL UP!' diamond overlay (Tap to continue) renders on top of the summary and intercepts the rf-done button. Playwright click on rf-done with force=True did not dismiss the overlay nor reach Done; required re-entering /rapid to reach the lobby. Likely a modal/overlay z-index or event-blocking issue — not blocking on reload but blocks the natural flow. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter118/01_summary.jpeg

issues: Alphabetical ordering within a subject is used when every row has equal 'cards to recover' (1). Review request (c) says 'most cards to recover first' — current behaviour is correct for ties but a worked ordering with mixed counts was not exercised in this call

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix Level-Up overlay intercepting rf-done on the session-complete summary. Reproduction: play any Rapid Fire round that produces a Level Up, press rf-done, then try to press it again — the 'Tap to continue' diamond overlay has no explicit testID and blocks the summary action buttons until it animates away. Proposed fix: render the LevelUp overlay on top of the summary ONLY after rf-done is dismissed, or gate rf-done press-ability on levelUpVisible && !shown, or add a `pointerEvents='none'` to the diamond visual.

rca_of_issue: Level Up overlay blocking rf-done — Repro: start any Rapid Fire session that will push the learner across a level threshold (currently cheap: Solo Sprint PCM 30 cards -> +160 XP easily crosses Level 1 -> 2). After the round finishes, the summary renders and simultaneously a full-screen 'LEVEL UP!' diamond overlay appears on top. Clicking rf-done with Playwright force=True does not reach the button because the overlay is in the same stacking context. Expected: rf-done remains tappable OR the Level Up is a step before the summary, not on top of it. Actual: button is covered until the overlay auto-dismisses (observed to still be covering after several seconds in this run — had to reload /rapid to proceed). File to inspect: /app/frontend/app/rapid/session.tsx (summary render + reward panel). Proposed fix: either render the Level Up as a sequence (reward -> Level Up overlay -> dismiss on Tap -> show summary buttons) or make the decorative Level Up View `pointerEvents='box-none'` so taps pass through to rf-done, plus add a `testID='rf-levelup-overlay'` for the testers.
